claims.text: The resort hotel overlooks a nature reserve and has easy beach access.

findings.quote: Our resort hotel overlooks a tranquil nature reserve, providing serene views, easy beach access, a refreshing on-site spa and pool and exceptional Rio restaurants.
findings.note: States both the nature reserve view and easy beach access.

claims.text: The hotel is near Barra da Tijuca, an area known for its beach, shopping and urban attractions.

findings.quote: explore the nearby Barra da Tijuca, one of Rio's most exclusive areas, known for its beach paradise, shopping and vibrant urban attractions
findings.note: Names nearby Barra da Tijuca and its beach, shopping and urban attractions.

claims.text: Rooms look out to the Atlantic Ocean and to sunsets over the lagoon.

findings.quote: Marvel at views of the Atlantic Ocean and breathtaking sunsets on the lagoon from the rooms at our Rio de Janeiro hotel.
findings.note: Covers both Atlantic Ocean views and lagoon sunsets from the rooms.

claims.text: Atiaia Spa has nine treatment suites, three of them for couples.

findings.quote: Atiaia Spa has nine exclusive suites with three designated for couples’ treatments.
findings.note: Nine suites, three of them for couples.

claims.text: Atiaia means luminosity in Tupi-Guarani, one of Brazil's native languages.

findings.quote: Atiaia—which means “luminosity” in one of Brazil’s native languages, Tupi-Guarani—is a true sanctuary
findings.note: Gives the meaning and the language.

claims.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool with views of the surrounding area.

findings.quote: Relax with a refreshing swim in our spectacular hotel pool with stunning views of the surrounding area.
findings.note: Appears under the 'Outdoor Pool' heading.

claims.text: Grand Club guests get a breakfast buffet and an afternoon cocktail hour with appetizers.

findings.quote: Guests with access to the Grand Club service are entitled to a delicious breakfast buffet and an afternoon cocktail hour with various appetizers and alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages
findings.note: Covers the breakfast buffet and the afternoon cocktail hour with appetizers.

claims.text: Resort amenities include beach service with sunbeds, parasols and towels.

findings.quote: Beach service with sunbeds, parasols and towels
findings.note: Listed among the services covered by the resort fee.

claims.text: The Kids Club has a ball pit, a trampoline, table football, a slide, video games and a baby area.

findings.quote: Our Kids Club offers toys and activities like a ball pit, a trampoline, table football, a slide, video games, a baby area and much more.
findings.note: All six listed items are named.

claims.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours and has a multifunctional studio with training sessions and yoga classes.

findings.quote: 24-Hour Fitness Center
findings.note: Establishes 24-hour operation.

findings.quote: Additionally, our large, multifunctional studio features training sessions and yoga classes.
findings.note: Covers the multifunctional studio with training sessions and yoga.

claims.text: Shiso is the hotel's Japanese restaurant, with an open kitchen, a sake bar and the Omakase Zen tasting menu.

findings.quote: Shiso, our award-winning Japanese restaurant at Grand Hyatt Rio de Janeiro
findings.note: Establishes Shiso as the hotel's Japanese restaurant.

findings.quote: Inspired by the fusion of traditional Eastern elements with contemporary and Carioca interpretations, Shiso’s open kitchen is an invitation to discover more about the behind-the-scenes of an award-winning restaurant.
findings.note: Covers the open kitchen.

findings.quote: Explore our varied menu with diverse options and the Omakase Zen, a tasting menu featuring dishes selected by the chef. In addition, enjoy the sake bar
findings.note: Covers the Omakase Zen tasting menu and the sake bar.

claims.text: Canto Gastro & Lounge was designed by Arthur Casas and has a large mural inspired by Roberto Burle Marx.

findings.quote: Designed by Arthur Casas, the restaurant offers a casual yet chic ambiance, featuring a large mural inspired by Roberto Burle Marx.
findings.note: Covers both the designer and the mural.

claims.text: The rooms were designed by the international design studio Yabu Pushelberg, using native stones and exclusive fabrics.

findings.quote: designed by the renowned international design studio Yabu Pushelberg, the rooms offer the perfect escape, inspired by local surroundings and incorporating native stones and exclusive fabrics
findings.note: Covers the designer and the materials.

claims.text: Every room and suite has a large private balcony.

findings.quote: All 436 rooms and suites—each with a large private balcony—are perfect escape venues
findings.note: States that every room and suite has a large private balcony.

claims.text: Suites offer dining and living areas with landscaped terraces, and some have an infinity pool.

findings.quote: Upgrade to one of the 43 suites for enhanced features, including spacious dining and living areas with landscaped terraces or even an infinite pool.
findings.note: Covers dining and living areas with terraces; the page says 'infinite pool', read here as an infinity pool.

claims.text: The Grand Club Lounge has panoramic views of Praia da Barra and Lagoa de Marapendi.

findings.quote: The space has panoramic views of Praia da Barra and Lagoa de Marapendi.
findings.note: Refers to the Grand Club Lounge.

claims.text: The nearest Metro station in Barra da Tijuca is a 15-minute drive from the hotel.

findings.quote: The nearest Metro station in Barra da Tijuca is a 15-minute drive from the hotel.
findings.note: Exact match.

claims.text: A daily resort fee applies to each room.

findings.quote: A daily resort fee of BRL 85 plus tax (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay
findings.note: Daily resort fee applied per room.

findings.quote: hotel policies include a daily resort fee of BRL 85 per room
findings.note: Confirms the per-room daily resort fee.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
